references.text: Regulations concerning vows and the valuation of what is vowed to the Lord, supplementing the rules about the Nazirite vow.
The complete law regarding the Nazirite that this verse summarizes.
Rules concerning voluntary offerings and vows to the Lord, related to the Nazirite's offering.
The command to keep vows made to the Lord, which applies to the Nazirite vow.
Exhortation to fulfill what one promises to God, relevant to the Nazirite's obligation.
Provisions concerning offerings according to ability, corresponding to 'as much as his hand can reach' in the Nazirite law.
The principle of offering according to ability, parallel to the Nazirite's additional vow.
